Customer **C-3847** received reply emails in the **wrong language** despite their contracted support language being **Portuguese (TB3M)**. The customer is requesting a refund of the **translation fee**.

   - **Verify eligibility:** Confirm the system reflects the refund eligibility for **€80 (translation fee)**.

   - **Update support language system:**
     - Log in to the **Contract System**.
     - Navigate to **Record C-3847** (Contract Details).
     - Update the **default communication language** to **Portuguese (TB3M)**.
     - **Verify:** Cross-check that no other discrepancies exist in the contract.

   - **Draft/refund confirmation email:**
     - **Subject:** Confirmation: Refund Processed for Translation Fee (Ticket C-3847)
     - **Body template:**
       > *"Dear [Customer Name],
       > We apologize for the inconvenience caused by the incorrect language in our previous responses. Your refund of **€80** for the translation fee has been processed and will reflect in your account within **3-5 business days**.
       >
       > To prevent future issues, we’ve updated your support language to **Portuguese (TB3M)** in our system. All further communications will adhere to this.
       >
       > For questions, reply to this email or reference **Ticket C-3847**.
       > Thank you for your patience,
       > [Your Team/Support Name]"*
     - **Send via:** Customer’s preferred channel (email: [@support.email recorded in CRM]).

   - **Optional:** Add a **case note** in the CRM for follow-up tracking (e.g., *"Refund issued; language corrected"*).

#### **4. Ticket Closure**
   - **Update ticket status:** Mark **C-3847** as **"Resolved (Refund + Language Correction)"**.
   - **Add closure note:**
     > *"Refund of €80 issued for incorrect language support. Contract updated to Portuguese (TB3M). Customer notified via email. No further action required."*

---
**Dependencies:**
- Refund system access (confirm with [Finance/Accounting team] if manual approval is needed).
- Contract system edit permissions.

**Deadline:** Execute within **24 hours** to meet SLAs.

---
**Writer’s Notes:**
- If the refund fails, escalate to **worker-Y** for reassessment.
- Attach this handoff to the ticket for executor reference.
